stages.attempt: A candle is slowly moved from beyond C toward P of a concave mirror. Explain how a real screen image changes before and after crossing F.
stages.reconstruct: As d drops toward F from above, v becomes increasingly negative and magnification grows. At F rays parallel; inside F rays diverge and extensions meet behind mirror, virtual upright. Crossing C only changes size.
